 Dosage 
 
 5 – 10 ml with equal quantity of water twice daily. 
 
 Properties 
 Karpooradi Arka formulation is enriched with fruitful herbs that are known to manage body’s certain aliments related digestive and cardiac systems. Karpooradi Arka is known to contain Stimulant, Diaphoretic Disinfectant, and Anti-Oxidant, Anti- Inflammatory and Carminative properties. These properties show positive effect on the body. Simulant and diaphoretic properties of the formulation known is to enhance alertness, tighten blood vessels, increase blood pressure, induce perspiration and help to get rid of harmful toxins present in the blood and body. These properties known to manage the condition of digestion and circulatory problems. Another is carminative properties that provide relief from gas, bloating problem. Being disinfectant and antimicrobial, Karpooradi Arka is known to kill microbes and other germs. Due to this feature Karpooradi Arka is known to take care of the problem of halitosis (bad breath). Its anti-oxidant properties help to remove toxins out from the body. These free radicals cause problem of tissue and cell destruction that further lead to cardiovascular problems, so this property helps to manage cardiac issues very well. It’s another property, anti-inflammatory – a property known to manage joint/muscles inflammation and pain.

 Weak digestion 
 Anorexia/Loss of appetite 
 High cholesterol levels 
 Cardiac disorders 
 Obesity 
 Halitosis

 Over dosage should be discouraged. 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
